stem: In triangle \(ABC\), angle \(C\) is a right angle and \(\cos(90^{\circ} - A) = 0.28\). What is the value of \(\tan B\)?
solution: \(\cos(90^{\circ} - A) = \sin A\), so \(\sin A = 0.28 = \frac{7}{25}\). Take \(BC = 7\) (opposite \(A\)) and \(AB = 25\).
For angle \(B\), the opposite leg is \(AC\) and the adjacent leg is \(BC\): \(\tan B = \frac{24}{7}\).
verify:
sA=Rational('0.28')
BC,AB=7,25
assert Rational(BC,AB)==sA
AC=sqrt(AB**2-BC**2)
ans=Rational(AC,BC)
assert AC==24 and ans==sqrt(1-sA**2)/sA
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans==Rational(24,7)
